answer: Divergent Challenge Ledger: each identity must periodically publish a unique response to a random challenge derived from its own transaction history. A clone sharing copied state still produces identical answers, so on the shared atlas of recorded responses only one account survives each challenge round. Honest identities diverge naturally across their voyage of interactions, while clones collide and get flagged. Enforcement: colliding accounts forfeit future challenge eligibility, and recovering requires a fresh ledge of independently accrued history.
